jobs.title: Staff Implementation Specialist
jobs.description:
What You'll Do:
#### **Role Summary**


The Principal Consultant is one of Avalara's most senior and impactful practitioners in the implementation discipline. This role leads our most complex and strategically significant customer engagements, defines the methodology that scales across the practice, and serves as the go\-to escalation resource when the most challenging implementation scenarios arise. It is a practice\-shaping role for a practitioner who takes pride in setting the standard and building the team around them.

  

Avalara's implementation practice sits at the intersection of tax complexity, enterprise technology, and customer outcomes. As our customer base expands in scale, global reach, and strategic importance, enterprise customers increasingly need a trusted expert who can translate sophisticated, multi\-jurisdictional tax requirements into scalable implementation architectures \- someone who raises the bar not just within a single engagement, but across the entire practice.

#### **How This Role Elevates Avalara**


This role will:

* Set the standard for implementation excellence across ERP, POS, and eCommerce environments, establishing best practices and repeatable frameworks the broader team adopts.
* Elevate team capability by mentoring and developing senior and mid\-level specialists, raising the quality of implementation delivery across the practice.
* Reduce delivery risk for Avalara's most strategically significant customers through direct ownership of the most complex, highest\-stakes engagements.
* Drive systemic improvement by identifying patterns across customer implementations and translating them into process improvements, tooling enhancements, and scalable playbooks.
* Influence Avalara's product roadmap by representing the implementation function in cross\-functional forums with Product, Engineering, and Customer Success, closing systemic delivery gaps and driving platform improvements.
* Advance Avalara's AI\-first strategy by embedding AI\-enabled approaches into implementation methodology, discovery, solution design, and team capability development.

  


What Your Responsibilities Will Be:#### **Responsibilities**


The successful candidate will:

* Architect and deliver end\-to\-end implementations across the full suite of supported ERP and platform integrations, including Sage, Microsoft Dynamics, Salesforce, Stripe Invoicing, NetSuite, and QuickBooks, at the highest level of complexity and customization.
* Own a portfolio of Avalara's most strategically critical customer implementations, ensuring delivery quality that sets a benchmark for the practice.
* Design and lead discovery engagements with enterprise and global customers, synthesizing complex tax workflow requirements into tailored, scalable implementation architectures.
* Identify systemic patterns across the customer portfolio and translate them into process improvements, tooling enhancements, and scalable frameworks that benefit the entire practice.
* Influence implementation methodology by recommending enhancements to playbooks, onboarding materials, training curricula, and SOPs that govern how the team operates.
* Serve as the escalation point for unresolved implementation and support challenges, providing expert guidance to senior and junior specialists.
* Partner with Implementation leadership as a thought leader on strategy, methodology evolution, and the future direction of the implementation practice.
* Represent the implementation function in cross\-functional forums with Product, Engineering, and Customer Success to influence the product roadmap and resolve systemic delivery gaps.
* Mentor and develop senior and mid\-level specialists through structured coaching on implementation methodology, advanced ERP configurations, and customer engagement strategies.
* Leverage AI tools to accelerate discovery synthesis, solution design, documentation, and implementation planning across complex customer engagements.

#### **12\-Month Success Signals**


Within the first 12 months, this consultant will:

* Deliver enhanced implementation playbooks, onboarding materials, and SOPs that measurably improve delivery consistency across the team.
* Successfully own and close a portfolio of Avalara's most complex and strategically significant customer implementations at or above quality benchmarks.
* Establish at least one new methodology or framework adopted as standard practice by the broader implementation team.
* Reduce escalation volume through proactive identification of systemic implementation risks and structured root\-cause resolution.
* Influence at least one Product or Engineering priority through cross\-functional engagement backed by implementation data and customer evidence.
* Demonstrate measurable use of AI in discovery, solution design, or documentation that improves speed, consistency, or delivery quality.
* Develop senior specialists through structured coaching, with observable improvement in methodology application and customer engagement quality.

  


What You'll Need to be Successful:
#### **AI Bar Raiser Expectations**


At Avalara, Principal Consultants are expected to be AI Bar Raisers, leaders who improve how AI is applied across implementation methodology, discovery, solution design, and team capability development. This role shapes the standard for applied AI in implementation and elevates the AI capability of the consultants and teams around them.


The successful candidate will:

* Leverage approved AI tools to accelerate discovery synthesis, requirements documentation, solution design, and implementation planning across complex customer engagements.
* Identify opportunities where AI can improve delivery consistency, reduce manual effort, and accelerate customer time\-to\-value across the practice.
* Apply AI responsibly and securely, ensuring all AI\-enabled approaches align with customer requirements and Avalara's governance standards.
* Demonstrate measurable improvements in implementation quality, productivity, or customer outcomes through AI\-enabled approaches \- not occasional use.
* Share AI best practices, reusable prompts, and implementation patterns that elevate AI capability across the consulting and implementation teams.

#### **Bar Raiser Expectations**


At Avalara, we hire Bar Raisers, leaders who strengthen organizations through deeper expertise, stronger execution, and a lasting commitment to raising the standard for everyone around them. As a Principal Consultant, this role is expected to elevate implementation methodology, improve team capability, and drive better outcomes for Avalara's most important customers.


The successful candidate will:

* Hold themselves and the team to high standards of implementation quality, customer engagement, and delivery accountability.
* Mentor and develop senior and mid\-level specialists, raising the capability of the broader team through coaching, knowledge sharing, and example.
* Identify root causes across the customer portfolio and build scalable, repeatable solutions that improve the practice for everyone.
* Exercise sound judgment when navigating complex customer requirements, competing stakeholder priorities, and technical constraints.
* Influence implementation strategy, methodology, and tooling through cross\-functional engagement and data\-backed recommendations.
* Leave every engagement, playbook, process, and team they touch stronger than they found it.

#### **Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Information Technology, Business Administration, Accounting, Engineering, or a related discipline and 12\+ years of experience in software implementation within the B2B sector, with a demonstrated track record of leading complex, multi\-platform, enterprise\-scale deployments.
* Recognized expert in tax automation: extensive experience independently architecting and delivering implementations of tax engines, returns, and exemption certificate systems for Avalara, TaxJar, Vertex, Sovos, Sabrix, or comparable platforms.
* Deep knowledge of sales and use tax compliance, nexus rules, and multi\-jurisdictional requirements; familiarity with VAT and international tax frameworks.
* Proven expertise across ERP and platform integrations including Sage, Microsoft Dynamics, Salesforce, NetSuite, and QuickBooks.
* Exceptional executive presence and communication skills; demonstrated ability to navigate complex stakeholder dynamics and engage with confidence at the executive level on both customer and internal sides.
* Established track record of developing talent, formally or informally mentoring specialists and raising team\-wide capability in implementation methodology and ERP configurations.
* Systems\-level thinker who identifies root causes across a customer portfolio and builds scalable, repeatable solutions that benefit the entire practice.
* Demonstrated use of AI tools to materially improve implementation speed, quality, consistency, or delivery outcomes.


Avalara is an AI\-first Company:

AI is embedded in our workflows, decision\-making, and products. Success here requires embracing AI as an essential capability.* You’ll bring experience using AI and AI\-related technologies, ready to thrive here.
* You’ll apply AI every day to business challenges \- improving efficiency, contributing solutions, and driving results for your team, our company, and our customers.
* You’ll grow with AI by staying curious about new trends and best practices, and by sharing what you learn so others can benefit too.


How We'll Take Care of You:

Total Rewards


In addition to a great compensation package, paid time off, and paid parental leave, many Avalara employees are eligible for bonuses.

  

Health \& Wellness  

Benefits vary by location but generally include private medical, life, and disability insurance.  

Inclusive culture and diversity  

Avalara strongly supports diversity, equity, and inclusion, and is committed to integrating them into our business practices and our organizational culture. We also have a total of 8 employee\-run resource groups, each with senior leadership and exec sponsorship.  


What You Need To Know About Avalara:

We’re defining the relationship between tax and tech.  

We’ve already built an industry\-leading cloud compliance platform, processing over 54 billion customer API calls and over 6\.6 million tax returns a year. Our growth is real \- we're a billion dollar business \- and we’re not slowing down until we’ve achieved our mission \- to be part of every transaction in the world.  

We’re bright, innovative, and disruptive, like the orange we love to wear. It captures our quirky spirit and optimistic mindset. It shows off the culture we’ve designed, that empowers our people to win. We’ve been different from day one. Join us, and your career will be too. **We’re An Equal Opportunity Employer**
Supporting diversity and inclusion is a cornerstone of our company — we don’t want people to fit into our culture, but to enrich it. All qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, age, gender, national orientation, disability, sexual orientation, US Veteran status, or any other factor protected by law. If you require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know.

jobs.title: Implementation Specialist
jobs.description:
#### **Job Description: Implementation Specialist**


Department: Implementation



Location: Corporate HQ



Report to: Implementation Supervisor



Position Summary: This position will execute and coordinate the execution of new customer implementations in accordance with customer, Ai and regulatory agency requirements and oversee projects and relationships with customer, exceeding customer expectations.


#### **Essential Duties and Responsibilities**


This position includes the following responsibilities. Other duties may be assigned to meet business needs.


* Coordinate/perform Account Setups in all applicable Ai operating systems and CRM system
* Work with Level II and Sr. Implementation Specialists to master confident discussion of all applicable paperwork, and ordering and delivery options of services
* Perform Spec Changes becoming familiar with effects spec changes have on system workflow and hone the ability to suggest best practices to clients based on requested changes
* Perform credentialing/vetting of clients, owners/operators, and requestors/contacts for each new account or client spec change.
* Act as liaison for internal and external communications for all accounts being implemented
* Coordinate product/service expectations with related departments
* Record/validate client specifications
* Collaborate with sales, marketing, support, operations, IT and accounting to ensure the successful launch and performance of all newly implemented accounts
* Address client issues with problem solving skills to offer timely and accurate solutions
* Coordinate User Training and System Demonstrations (Demos) for Level II and Sr. Implementation Specialists
* Back up Implementation Specialist II

#### **Qualification/ Requirements**

* Strong customer service skills (friendly, courteous and helpful)
* Ability to communicate effectively, make presentations and write concise reports for all levels of employees
* Be able to project a professional company image inperson, through email and phone interaction
* Must be computer literate and proficient in Microsoft Office, Outlook, Word, Adobe Acrobat X Pro and Excel
* Able to analyze information gathered to identify potential problems or discrepancies
* Ability to properly handle confidential information and records
* Must be able to focus on tasks and excel in attention to detail and accuracy
* Work independently and as part of a team
* Strong keyboard skills (60 WPM, 95% accuracy)
* Ability to operate standard office equipment, including but not limited to, computers, telephone systems, copiers, scanners, and facsimile machines

#### **Supervisory Responsibility**

* This position has no supervisory responsibilities


Position Type/Expected Hours of Work


* The position is a fulltime position
* The employee must be available and present between the hours of 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., MF

#### **Travel**

* This position may require up to 5% of travel travel will frequently be outside the local area and overnight trips may be required

#### **Education/Training/Experience**

* High School Education or GED equivalent.

#### **About Applicant Insight Inc dba aINSIGHT**


HISTORY Founded in 1990, Applicant Insight is a privately held leader in delivering Customized Candidate Onboarding Solutions, Background Screening Services, Clinical Services including Drug Testing, Credential Management, Forms Automation, and Consulting Services to clients involved in heavily regulated and non\-regulated industries requiring extensive document management, compliance\-driven customized workflows, rigorous reporting, scheduling, and tracking. Applicant Insight prides itself on our culture, relying heavily on our values of integrity, transparency, collaboration, and commitment! Through an emergent culture focused on open door policy and servant leadership, as well as our collective commitment to our Company principals, we create an environment that is unique with opportunities. MISSION To be an industry leading single source provider of solution driven screening, credentialing, and workflow management. VISION To become one of the top five providers in our industry.

jobs.title: EHR Training & Implementation Specialist
jobs.description:
**About Ezderm**

Ezderm is a high\-growth healthcare technology company dedicated to modernizing the dermatology experience. We build intuitive, cloud\-based electronic health records (EHR) and practice management solutions that empower providers to focus on what matters most: patient care. Driven by innovation and a culture of resilience, we bridge the gap between complex medical workflows and seamless digital efficiency. At Ezderm, we don’t just provide software; we build the foundational tools that help dermatology practices thrive and scale in a rapidly evolving digital landscape.

**Summary/Objective:**

The Client Success Specialist is responsible for delivering exceptional onboarding, training, and ongoing support to Ezderm's dermatology practice clients. In this role, you will serve as a trusted product expert — helping practices get the most out of Ezderm's EHR and Practice Management platform through hands\-on training, responsive issue resolution, and proactive engagement. The ideal candidate brings healthcare IT experience, a consultative mindset, and the ability to build strong relationships with both clinical and administrative teams in a fast\-paced, client\-facing environment.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**

* **Client Training \& Onboarding:** Serve as an Ezderm product expert and deliver engaging, role\-specific training for new and existing clients across our full software suite — EHR, Practice Management, Patient Portal, and third\-party integrations. Partner with the Implementation team to support smooth practice onboarding and ensure clients are set up for long\-term success.
* **Support \& Issue Resolution:** Provide responsive, high\-quality support to clients via phone, email, and our online community. Diagnose and resolve software issues efficiently, communicate solutions clearly, and escalate complex cases with full context and documentation.
* **Product Expertise \& Feedback Loop:** Maintain deep, current knowledge of Ezderm's features, workflows, and updates. Proactively identify recurring client pain points and share structured feedback with Product and Engineering to inform roadmap decisions.
* **Content \& Community:** Contribute to the development and maintenance of support resources, including knowledge base articles, how\-to guides, and tutorial videos. Engage actively in the Ezderm community to answer questions, surface trends, and foster a positive user experience.

jobs.description:
Located in the metropolitan area of Sacramento, the Adventist Health corporate headquarters have been based in Roseville, California, for more than 40 years. In 2019, we unveiled our WELL\-certified campus \- a rejuvenating place for associates systemwide to collaborate, innovate and connect.
  

  

Adventist Health Roseville and shared service teams have access to enjoy a welcoming space designed to promote well\-being and inspire your best work.


Job Summary:


Adventist Health Roseville is seeking an EHR Certified Systems Analyst II (Behavioral Health) for a full\-time position on 8\-hour day shifts. This remote role may require up to 25% travel. We are seeking a qualified professional to support our team and stakeholders while working remotely.


Performs various duties relating to information systems applications including the design, build, implementation, support, and testing of computer software and related processes. Works with project and support teams to ensure appropriate development, training, support, and evaluation of major computer applications.


Job Requirements:


Education and Work Experience:


* Associate's/Technical Degree or equivalent combination of education/related experience: Required
* Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent combination of education/related experience: Preferred
* Three healthcare IT application/technical experience or equivalent: Required
* Two years’ applicable Epic application experience: Preferred
Licenses/Certifications:


* Epic Certification/Accreditation in area of responsibility: Required
Essential Functions:


* Maintains moderately complex system software utilizing established standards and departmental protocols, to meet user requests/specifications. Evaluates user requests for special enhancements to system software. Works with customers to gather specifications for the purchase, development, and installation of system software. Maintains service level agreements with various end\-user departments and enterprise business units.
* Coordinates analysis of documentation and workflows in departments, and designs/redesigns system components to support appropriate workflows. Assists in analyzing existing methods and developing alternatives to increase operations and production efficiency. Performs a needs assessment for complex workflows, customers, and/or clinical/revenue areas. Analyzes and documents reporting needs of end users. Identifies potential process and/or department\-specific risks and assists in strategies to mitigate or resolve them.
* Develops and follows project work plans. Leads project meetings and works cooperatively with team members to coordinate assigned duties with the overall program and related projects. Researches, documents, and facilitates resolution to issues reported by end\-users. Tests system software per checklist guidelines and participates in the development of test scenarios. Collaborates with technical teams to define hardware/network requirements and to research and problem\-solve technical issues.
* Presents training to a variety of audiences. Ensures that system documentation is current and available to the customer and that customers are educated as to where to find it. Assesses how users are progressing with their use of system applications and assists with optimization training to further develop user proficiency, efficiency, and satisfaction. Leads optimization activities to ensure staff effectively use the systems.
* Handles ongoing on call duties for one or more applications which generate Incidents outside of business hours. Provides on call support as needed of the most critical applications. Troubleshoots and resolves system issues escalated by the help desk. As needed, up to 25%, travel on site to provide support during go\-live events and other work\-related occasions. Travel could occur during standard off\-hours support times.
* Performs other job\-related duties as assigned.
